conditions: The block localizes the ordinary symbols listed in its local-variable specification.
limitations: Initialization order and behavior of special symbols or special evaluation controls require additional conditions.

statement: The Wolfram Language 14.3 reference documents Block as dynamically localizing listed symbols' values. Their original values are restored when the block finishes, and their names stay the same.
